shared_candidate_pool.dedup: Exact duplicate candidates collapse but no replacement sample is drawn.

arms.A0: Greedy single output from the same frozen generator; practical baseline, not the primary gate-isolation contrast.
arms.A1: Shared K candidates ranked by length-normalized generator log-probability; top candidate selected. No authority legality filter.
arms.A2: Shared K candidates filtered to legal/support set; return legal set with deterministic stable ordering and abstain/review if empty/conflicted. No learned ranking.
arms.A3: Shared K candidates filtered exactly as A2, then ranked inside legal set by the same length-normalized log-probability as A1.

learned_score.metric: length-normalized conditional log probability under frozen generator
learned_score.forbidden: interpreting higher score as native preference or writing quality

isolation_rules: A1 and A3 must see byte-identical candidate pools.
A2 and A3 must use byte-identical legality/support decisions.
No candidate regeneration after legality result.
A0 is reported separately because candidate budget differs.
output_policy: Persist generated outputs only when source license/custody permits; otherwise persist hashes, metrics and minimal derived receipts.
